subject: RE: FW: BRUSSELS AIRPORT - SIN / 34 PCS 740 KGS
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well. Could you quote the fastest air freight option to ORD (Chicago, US) for a shipment of automotive sensors? We have 6 pieces with a gross weight of 246 kg and a volume of 1.10 cbm.

The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-29 at our site in 50107 (Cologne), Germany. Could you arrange the truck from our site to the airport and include that in your all-in price in EUR?

Could you also let me know the earliest arrival you can offer at ORD?

Thanks for checking!

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg


-----Original Message-----
Sent: 2026-10-16
Subject: BRUSSELS AIRPORT - SIN / 34 PCS 740 KGS

Dear team,

pls quote air freight ex BRUSSELS AIRPORT to SIN:
34 PCS / 740 KGS / 1.5 CBM, spare parts for packaging machines
FCA, cargo ready next week.

Thanks

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new all-in quote for an air shipment from Cologne to Chicago, including pickup and earliest arrival.
